actual_traffic_seed: scene*1009+repeat_seed via TrafficManager.seed immediately before its native reset; map stays reset(seed=scene)
B: previous frozen causal low-pass steering; unchanged current SAC pedal
C: single selected tracking variant, frozen before holdout
current_pedal: exact original SAC, no new brake/recovery policy
future_feedback: original low-level tracker follows the current frozen SAC path; NOT a simulated future SAC replanner

lowpass.formula: alpha*u_SAC+(1-alpha)*actual_previous, clipped around current SAC; throttle unchanged

comfort_index.definition: mean of raw steering_rate_RMS and SG-filtered actual longitudinal_jerk_RMS/lateral_jerk_RMS/lateral_accel_RMS normalized by map-level development medians

selection_rule: development: no success/crash/OOR deterioration; route>=A-0.005; mean discounted gain>0; positive gains on >=6/12 maps. Choose success then return. Otherwise do not use holdout.
joint_acceptance: heldout actual return95%CI lower>0; success> A; crash/OOR mean not higher; route not lower; improved return on majority of maps and both traffic repeats; planner P95<=100ms; compare simple filter. Report bounds/CI even if point targets pass.
scene_integrity: record actual road geometry hash, native flags and full-body road coverage at termination. Retain all failed maps; disagreement is not automatically an environment bug.
native_hypothesis: Actual physics solid-line/sidewalk boxes represent native line contacts better than the road union. Add the same continuous coefficient20 term, compare always-search and nominal-risk-only search, steering-only, no reward/done modifications.
native_envelope_source: old24 trajectories only: mean map H5 position P95 + half vehicle length*heading P95; NOT a probabilistic safety guarantee
technical_gate: Validate actual-state planar contact vs original native contact labels on existing traces before collecting any new driving outcomes.
native_zero_risk_policy: Risk-only variant executes exact SAC if baseline line/road/obstacle modeled risk is zero; when active retain64 proposals+baseline,8elites,4iterations.
